say:1:1041577001:1.text: Oh? Another great king in my presence. My deepest respects, Your Majesty.
say:1:1041577001:1.source_cn: 哦？又一位伟大的国王陛下，向您致以敬意。

say:2:1041577002:1.text: Your Majesty? Where? I don't see any kings around here!
say:2:1041577002:1.source_cn: 国王陛下？这里哪儿有国王陛下？

say:3:1041577003:1.text: I've long heard that King Rolan was the most handsome man in the empire. I came here to see him for myself.
say:3:1041577003:1.source_cn: 早就听闻罗兰大帝是耀光首屈一指的俊美男子，我特此前来，...

say:4:1041577004:1.text: Though it seems that, rather than showing the world that handsome face, you prefer presenting yourself in this sly little form instead?
say:4:1041577004:1.source_cn: 原来比起俊美的容颜，您更喜欢以这副狡黠的模样示人吗？

say:5:1041577005:1.text: My, my... if you put it that way, I can hardly brush you off now.
say:5:1041577005:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，你要这样说，我倒不好意思敷衍你了。

say:7:1041577006:1.text: Is this more to your satisfaction?

say:9:1041577008:1.text: If the recruitment of the royal guard hadn't already been entrusted to Indris, I might've selected a few soldiers in your likeness solely to improve the view around the palace.
say:9:1041577008:1.source_cn: 如果不是卫兵招募这种事已经被我交接给了因度厄，我多少要...

say:10:1041577009:1.text: So, was that furry form just a bit of lighthearted mischief?
say:10:1041577009:1.source_cn: 所以，您刚才那副样貌，只是个小小的恶作剧？

say:11:1041577010:1.text: Think of it as a clever disguise.
say:11:1041577010:1.source_cn: 你就把它理解为一个巧妙的障眼法吧。

say:12:1041577011:1.text: Otherwise, my descendants would hunt me down every few decades just to weep at my feet about how difficult their lives are.
say:12:1041577011:1.source_cn: 不这样的话，每隔几十年，我的那些后辈们一定会千方百计地...

say:13:1041577012:1.text: And in the end, it always comes back to the same thing: they want me to take the throne again.
say:13:1041577012:1.source_cn: 最终的目的一定是让我当回耀光的国王。

say:15:1041577014:1.text: Creating an empire and maintaining one are entirely different matters.
say:15:1041577014:1.source_cn: 开创秩序和维持秩序可是完全不同的两件事。

say:16:1041577015:1.text: Besides, once you've finally escaped that sort of life, you never wish to return to it.
say:16:1041577015:1.source_cn: 再说，一旦从那种生活里解脱出来，就再也不想回到那种生活里了。

say:17:1041577016:1.text: Watching others busy themselves with burdens you've already left behind is far more entertaining.
say:17:1041577016:1.source_cn: 反倒是看着别人忙于那些我已从中脱身的事务，别有一番趣味。

say:19:1041577018:1.text: In my two thousand years as a spectator, I've seen no shortage of political dramas. When it comes to seizing power, people often behave in ways far stranger than fiction.
say:19:1041577018:1.source_cn: 作为观众的这两千年，我可是看过了不少精彩的政治剧目，为...

say:20:1041577019:1.text: Oh? I'd love to hear the details.

say:21:1041577020:1.text: Fortunately, I have nowhere pressing to be... and we have all the time in the world. Please, indulge me with the full story.
say:21:1041577020:1.source_cn: 反正之后也无事要做……我们的时间还很多，您可以慢慢说。
